description: This file contains a PHP class implementing an API controller for handling payment address data within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines the PaymentAddress class that extends the base Controller class and includes methods for processing payment address information, validation, and storing details in the session, primarily used for order checkout operations.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: API controller class for managing payment address data during the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the retrieval and validation of payment address data submitted via POST request, storing validated data into session, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
